note: Not a filing entity and not a carrier. A synthetic key carrying the industry-wide oil pipeline rate-ceiling adjustment published annually under 18 CFR 342.3 (Docket RM93-11-000), so that one national instrument is stored once rather than fanned across every carrier. The delivered baseline attached this single index to 28 individual carriers, which is a scope error under Rule 3.3 and would let a consumer sum one national index 28 times.
